Hi everyone,
I’m writing again about our process. My partner is South African. after a long wait MH beer Sheva called us to say that my partner can go to the embassy in SA to collect his B/2 visa to enter Israel. After continuous communication with them, they told me that the document that MH sent me isn’t the correct one for our process. 

My partner is living in SA and I’m in Israel and I’ve started the gradual process from here. Now we don’t understand what we need to do. We have 2 weeks until the document is expiring according to MH. 

I’m attaching here both the document from MH and the answer from the embassy in SA. 

I’ll say that for now we cannot do walk-in at the embassy in SA, so all communication is via emails. 

Thank you 🙏🏻
